patch_description: Revert to the higher-scoring single-shared-parameter design (seed variant that reached combined score 0.80 with fast 30-step convergence), and enrich its zero-parameter skip-2 sub-ring with a parametrized CRY interaction that reuses a single new shared parameter "theta_e". This keeps parameter count minimal (2 unique names per block instead of the current program's 2 names but with worse-performing RY/RZ-only design) while adding a non-commuting tunable long-range interaction that should improve expressivity/generalization without hurting parameter economy. The design restores the alternating XX/CZ ring and antipodal CZ shortcuts from the best-performing prior candidate, and only changes the previously fixed CZ skip-2 links into CRY gates sharing "theta_e", per the recommendation.
